# AI PromptMatrix

> AI PromptMatrix is a curated library of high-quality AI image prompts for ChatGPT, Google Gemini (Nano Banana), Grok, and Qwen. Each prompt includes the exact text, the AI tool it targets, reference images, and copy-paste-ready instructions for recreating the artwork.

## About

AI PromptMatrix helps creators discover, copy, and reuse image-generation prompts. Every prompt is organized by the AI image tool it was built for, with example outputs and usage notes.

## Sections

- [Explore all prompts](https://aipromptmatrix.in/explore): Browse the full prompt library, filter by AI tool and category.
- [Guides](https://aipromptmatrix.in/guides): Step-by-step tutorials on getting the best results from AI image tools.
- [Blog](https://aipromptmatrix.in/blog): AI image trends, techniques, and prompt-writing tips.

## Supported AI tools

- ChatGPT (image generation)
- Google Gemini / Nano Banana
- Grok
- Qwen Image

## Usage

Prompts are free to browse and copy. See https://aipromptmatrix.in/terms for licensing and https://aipromptmatrix.in/contact for questions.
